scientific_integrity: The theorem is proved by a complete labeled-cycle analysis, independently checked by direct binary-source enumeration for periods 1 through 10 and exact transition calculations through 200; no independence or formal machine certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Binary, length-three, stride-two, indexed periodic observations only. The automaton and asymptotic rate are established in earlier noncyclic literature. An equivalent exact cyclic image formula in unindexed symbolic-dynamics literature cannot be ruled out.
title: Exact finite-length capacity and parity defect of cyclic binary transverse reads
